title.zh: 工艺选择：先分清要控制哪一种功函数
title.en: Route selection: identify which work function to control

subtitle.zh: 表面表征 / 接触工程 / 栅堆栈 EWF
subtitle.en: Surface characterization / contact engineering / gate-stack EWF

heading.zh: A 材料与表面功函数
heading.en: A Material and surface work function

body.zh: 目标：研究表面电子状态、吸附、晶面或材料变化。手段：UPS、Kelvin Probe、KPFM。证据：二次电子截止（表面功函数）、接触电势差（表面电势）、空间分布（表面不均匀性）。图中标注 E_vac、V_CPD、信号强度与动能。
body.en: Goal: study surface electronic states, adsorption, crystal planes, or material changes. Methods: UPS, Kelvin probe, KPFM. Evidence: secondary-electron cutoff (surface work function), contact-potential difference (surface potential), spatial distributions (surface nonuniformity). Diagram labels include E_vac, V_CPD, intensity, kinetic energy.

body.zh: 边界：半导体结果还包含表面态与能带弯曲，不等同于孤立材料的功函数。
body.en: Limit: semiconductor results include surface-state and band-bending effects and do not equal an isolated-material work function.

body.zh: 目标：优化势垒与接触电阻。结构：金属、经清洁/钝化的界面层、掺杂可调的半导体。手段：金属选择（图示 Ti、Ta、W、Co）、界面清洁或钝化、掺杂工程、退火协同。
body.en: Goal: optimize barrier and contact resistance. Structure: metal, cleaned/passivated interface, semiconductor with adjustable doping. Methods: metal choice (Ti, Ta, W, Co illustrated), interface cleaning/passivation, doping engineering, coordinated annealing.

body.zh: 证据：I–V（接触电阻与势垒）、温度依赖（热激发/隧穿机制）、TLM（传输线法，提取接触电阻）、界面成分（XPS/TEM-EDS 等）。边界：功函数只是输入之一，界面钉扎与化学反应可能主导实际势垒高度与接触电阻。
body.en: Evidence: I–V (contact resistance/barrier), temperature dependence (thermal activation/tunneling), TLM for contact resistance, and interface composition (XPS/TEM-EDS). Limit: work function is one input; interface pinning and chemistry can dominate actual barrier height/contact resistance.

body.zh: 目标：调节 V_FB 与 Vth。结构：金属栅（WFM）、偶极层或 Vth shifter、高 k、Si 衬底。手段：WFM 材料与厚度（图示 TiN/TaN、厚度 t）、双功函数 n/p 区域设计、偶极或 Vth shifter、热处理。
body.en: Goal: tune V_FB and Vth. Stack: WFM, dipole layer or Vth shifter, high-k, Si. Methods: WFM material/thickness (TiN/TaN and thickness t shown), dual-work-function n/p regions, dipole/Vth shifter, thermal treatment.

body.zh: 证据：MOSCAP C–V、I_d–V_g、EWF 与可靠性分布。边界：Vth 还受介质电荷、沟道特性与器件结构影响，不能仅用 WFM 功函数概括。
body.en: Evidence: MOSCAP C–V, I_d–V_g, EWF and reliability distributions. Limit: dielectric charge, channel properties, and device structure also affect Vth; WFM work function alone is insufficient.

heading.zh: D 三种调控方式对比

body.zh: WFM 成分/厚度：目标为调节 V_FB、Vth；n/p 独立调节能力中等（材料选择）；金属堆栈与退火要求较高；界面敏感性高（界面反应、扩散）；栅槽空间方面原图写“容易整合”；变异性与可靠性受界面与工艺影响；成本中等。
body.en: WFM composition/thickness: tune V_FB and Vth; medium independent n/p capability through material selection; demanding stack/anneal requirements; high interface sensitivity to reaction/diffusion; the source describes trench-space integration as easy; variability/reliability depend on interfaces/processes; medium cost.

body.zh: 偶极或 Vth shifter：微调 Vth、补偿工艺偏移；n/p 调节能力中等（偶极方向与强度）；热预算相对较低；界面敏感性高（偶极稳定性）；容易整合；变异性与可靠性取决于偶极层稳定性；成本中等。
body.en: Dipole or Vth shifter: fine-tune Vth and compensate process offsets; medium n/p capability through dipole direction/strength; relatively low thermal budget; high interface sensitivity to dipole stability; easy integration; variability/reliability depend on dipole stability; medium cost.

body.zh: 双 WFM 选择性整合：n/p 独立调节、Vth 窗口控制；调节能力强（分区不同 WFM）；热预算中等（需多道工艺）；界面敏感性高（跨区隔离与界面工程）；栅槽空间整合较复杂（选择性工艺）；需评估跨区一致性与长期可靠性；成本较高（多步与选择性工艺）。
body.en: Selective dual-WFM integration: independent n/p tuning and Vth-window control; strong capability via region-specific WFM; medium thermal budget with multiple steps; high interface sensitivity involving regional isolation/interface engineering; complex trench integration due to selectivity; assess cross-region consistency and long-term reliability; higher cost.

body.zh: 先定义工程目标，再选择调控手段与验证证据。量测反馈包括实验分片、物性—电性相关、热稳定性、可靠性。反馈动作：实验分片 → 物性与电性相关 → 热稳定性 → 决策评审。不同层级可以采用不同路线，不用单一材料功函数概括整套器件。
body.en: Define the engineering goal before selecting controls and evidence. Feedback includes experimental splits, physical–electrical correlation, thermal stability, and reliability. Actions: splits → physical/electrical correlation → thermal stability → decision review. Different levels may use different routes; a single material work function cannot represent the entire device.

notes.zh: 对比表中的“容易整合”、相对热预算及成本等级为原图的概括判断，未给出具体材料、结构和流程条件。
notes.en: The table’s ease-of-integration, relative thermal-budget, and cost ratings are source generalizations without specified materials, structures, or process conditions.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
